name: Pile sleeves, grout seals and grouted pile connections
description: The pile sleeve is the jacket-leg extension that receives a driven pile; the grout seal, packer and grout lines transfer load from pile to jacket through a grouted connection. Grouted connections are the standard jacket-to-pile interface and are fatigue- and capacity-critical.

gaps.what: Grouted connection capacity, sleeve overlap and grout grade
gaps.why: No page read prints a grouted-connection design value; the ISO 19902 and DNV-RP-0419 clause text was not read.
gaps.next_action: Fetch the grouted-connection requirements or a fabricator procedure and record overlap length, bond stress and grout grade with basis
